void.dm: The member gets a DM with your reason.
void.test: Test case: only the record is marked as a mistake. {dm}
void.alreadyEnded: It already ended, so nothing is lifted; the case is only marked as a mistake. {dm}
void.alreadyLifted: It was already lifted, so nothing is lifted; the case is only marked as a mistake. {dm}

lift.ban: The member is unbanned (and gets an invite back).
lift.warn: The warning stops counting toward the warning stages; a ban it caused is lifted.
lift.kick: There is nothing to lift for a kick; the case is marked as a mistake.
lift.fallback: What is still in effect is lifted.

result.dmFailed: The DM could not be delivered (DMs closed or no shared server); the action still ran.

access.needModRole: You need the moderator role or Administrator in this server to do this (it may have been removed since you logged in).
access.needAdmin: You need the Administrator permission in this server to do this.
access.ownerOnly: Only the bot owners can do this (like /staff restore).
access.enforcementAdmin: Enforcement actions need Administrator in this server (bot owners without it can view only).

expired.action: This confirmation expired or was already used. Nothing was done; preview the action again.
expired.bulk: This confirmation expired or was already used. Nothing was done; preview the bulk action again.
expired.void: This confirmation expired or was already used. Nothing was done; remove the case again.
expired.cases: This confirmation expired or was already used. Nothing was done; choose the cases again.
expired.appeal: This confirmation expired or was already used. Nothing was done; decide again.

members.bansFailed: The ban list could not be loaded (Discord or the database did not answer). Reload the page to try again.
members.noUserWithId: No Discord user with ID {id} exists.
members.noUser: There is no Discord user with that ID.
members.notAvailable: {action} is not available for {name} right now (reload the page).
members.warnWouldBan: This warning would automatically ban {name} (warn ladder), so it needs an Administrator.
members.chooseCountedWarn: Choose one of the member's counted warnings.
members.actionFailed: Something went wrong; nothing may have changed. Check the member's cases before retrying.
members.timeoutAdmin: Discord does not allow timing out a member with Administrator.
members.notVerified: {name} does not have the verified role.

bulk.tooManyMatch: {total} members match these filters; one bulk action can change at most {max}. Narrow the filters.
bulk.tickMember: Tick at least one member, or choose "everyone matching these filters".
bulk.tooMany: One bulk action can change at most {max} members.
bulk.blocked: You are blocked by the safety limit (too many bans or kicks in 10 minutes); nothing was done.
bulk.unknownJob: This bulk action is not known (it may be over an hour old, or the bot restarted).

case.noCase: There is no case with that code.
case.giveChange: Give a new reason or a new duration.
case.editedEnded: Case {code} edited: {fields}. The new end is already past: it will be lifted within a minute.
case.dmNotDelivered: DM to the member: not delivered.
case.noteAdded: Note added. Only staff can see it.

evidence.oneLink: Give one http(s) link, e.g. a Discord message link.
evidence.addedLinkOnly: Evidence #{id} added. The message could not be read (other server, no access or deleted), so only the link is saved.
evidence.notImage: That file is not a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image.
evidence.imageAdded: Image evidence #{id} added (re-hosted in the evidence channel).
evidence.removedImage: Evidence #{id} removed. Its copy in the evidence channel is kept.

cases.chooseAction: Choose what to do with the ticked cases.
cases.noneExist: None of the ticked cases exist in this server any more.
cases.removeMax: Remove at most {max} cases at once.
cases.giveReason: Give a reason for removing them (the members see it).
cases.allRemoved: Every ticked case is already removed.
cases.tagMax: Tag at most {max} cases at once.

appeal.noPending: There is no pending appeal for {code}.
appeal.ownerOverride: You issued this punishment: decided as a bot owner, logged as an owner override.

keepApart.pickBoth: Pick both members (type a name and choose one, or use Find a member), or paste their Discord user IDs.
keepApart.notUser: One of those IDs is not a Discord user.
keepApart.noBots: Keep-apart orders are between members, not bots.
keepApart.dmFailed: A DM could not be delivered to one of them.
keepApart.noOrder: There is no active keep-apart order #{id}.

watchlist.noEntry: There is no active watchlist entry #{id}.

staff.coverageFailed: Coverage could not be loaded (database unavailable).
staff.activityOwners: Weekly staff activity is shown to the bot owners only (like /staff activity).
staff.pickStaff: Staff member: pick a member (type a name and choose one, or use Find a member), or paste their Discord user ID.
staff.reasonRule: A reason is required (which admin rule they broke).
staff.cannotWarn: You cannot warn the owner or a bot.
staff.notInServer: That user is not in the server.
staff.warned: Staff warning given to {name}: {active} of {limit} active.
staff.demoted: That reached the limit: their staff roles were removed (restore them under Removed staff roles).
staff.noSavedRoles: No removed staff roles are saved for that user (or they are not in the server).
staff.noneBack: None of the saved roles could be given back to {name} (deleted or above my role).
